complexity.rationale: Single Rust crate, no code yet. Hard parts are byte-exact emulation of Composer's autoloader output and safe filesystem work (zip extraction, hardlinks into a shared cache, replacing vendor dirs); both are pinned by golden tests copied from Composer.

plan.rationale: Greenfield: cache layout, atomicity and compatibility decisions are cheap to plan and expensive to redo. Opus suffices; no distributed-systems complexity to justify fable. Routed to fable (pinned 2026-09-06): Fable has its own quota pool with headroom, while non-Fable subagents draw on the constrained shared pool.

code.rationale: Byte-diff goldens and Composer's own fixture tables catch emulation mistakes, so mid-tier is safe for TDD steps against an approved plan. Routed to fable (pinned 2026-09-06): Fable has its own quota pool with headroom, while non-Fable subagents draw on the constrained shared pool.

review.rationale: Small per-step diffs with clippy -D warnings and nextest in the gate; filesystem-mutating paths escalate below. Routed to fable (pinned 2026-09-06): Fable has its own quota pool with headroom, while non-Fable subagents draw on the constrained shared pool.

escalations.action: review at high effort (extracts untrusted zips into a shared cache, deletes and replaces vendor dirs, hardlinks share inodes with the cache)
